_note: Paper-only (fake money) XRP strategy variants run side by side on the same live data. Stakes above $10 (cost + fee) are clipped in code. 'timeframe' picks the Polymarket XRP market family: 5m = xrp-updown-5m, 1h = xrp-updown-1h. 'sides' limits which side a variant may bet. 'min_lead_pct' = XRP must already be at least this % of price past the price-to-beat in our direction. Thresholds calibrated for XRP from 14 days of Coinbase 1m candles (see tweaks/).

control.desc: CONTROL (5m): plain pure-model bettor, both sides, no lead gate, no trend filters. $1 +$1 per extra 1c of edge, cap $5 incl. fee, any time from 30-240s left, asks 5-95c

model_lead.desc: MODEL + LEAD GATE (5m): model blended 50/50 with market, 4c edge, only 180-240s left (3-4 min), and XRP must already be 0.055% (~0.05c) past the price-to-beat our way. Cap $5 incl. fee ($2 above 70c)

ride_favorite_80.desc: RIDE THE FAVORITE 80c+ (5m): buy whichever side the market favors, only when it costs 80-95c, with 60-120s left. Flat $5 incl. fee, no model

trend_volume.desc: TREND + VOLUME (5m, both ways): bets WITH the last hour's trend when 60m and 15m momentum agree, lower/higher highs and lows, and volume backs the move. 50/50 model+market +3c trend bonus, 3c edge, 90-240s left, asks 30-75c, cap $5 incl. fee. (Best BTC variant, ported with XRP's higher-volatility limit)

trend_down.desc: TREND RIDER, DOWN ONLY (5m): same idea as trend_volume but only bets Down, when the last hour is trending down (lower highs and lows) with 60m/15m momentum agreeing and volume at least equal on the down candles. 90-240s left, asks 25-80c, cap $5 incl. fee

breakdown.desc: BREAKDOWN, DOWN ONLY (5m): a finished 1-min candle closed below the prior 30-min low on 2x+ average volume and price is still below it. Bets Down. 3c edge, 90-240s left, asks 25-80c, $2 +$1 per 2c extra edge, cap $5 incl. fee ($3 above 70c)

down_ride.desc: DOWN RIDE (5m): bets Down only when XRP is ALREADY at least 0.055% (~0.05c) below the price-to-beat with 90-180s left (2-3.5 min into the window), a 'lead already built by 2-3 minutes in' setup.  Model+market blend, 3c edge after the ask and fee, asks 50-90c, flat-ish $2 +$1 per 2c extra edge, cap $5 incl. fee. Does NOT bet just because the last window was down.

hourly_ride_down.desc: HOURLY RIDE DOWN (1h market): bets Down mid-hour only if XRP is ALREADY at least 0.1% below the hour's price-to-beat with 30-45 min left (15-30 min in), and the broader 4-hour trend is net down (used only as a filter). Model+market blend, 3c edge after ask and fee, asks 40-85c, $2 +$1 per 2c extra edge, cap $5 incl. fee. Hourly spreads are 3-6c, so it fills at the ask.

auto_pick.desc: AUTO PICK (5m): every round it ranks the other 5m variants by net fake P&L on bets settled in the last 6 hours (falls back to since-start if nobody qualifies in the window). A variant qualifies with 5+ settled bets and positive P&L. It follows ONLY its current pick's bets (same side, same moment); if the pick doesn't bet in a window it sits out. New leader must be best at 2 straight checks. Flat $3 target incl. fee (rounded up to the 5-share minimum, never above $5 total; hard max $10). Own separate fake account.

bankroll_20.desc: BANKROLL $20→$1,000 (5m, fake money only): starts with a $20 fake-money balance and tries to grow it to $1,000. Follows ONLY the group's current auto_pick (other 5m variants ranked by 6-hour net fake P&L; 5+ settled bets and positive P&L to qualify; new leader must be best at 2 straight checks). Bets about 20% of its cash each time, rounded up to the 5-share minimum, never more than $10 including the taker fee, never more than the cash on hand. Stops if the balance can't cover a minimum order (busted) or once the $1,000 goal is hit. Own separate fake account; does not change the other variants.
